therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Autophagy modulation combined with chemotherapy and anti-angiogenesis
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of autophagy to enhance chemotherapy efficacy
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with advanced/recurrent non-small cell lung cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Tumor response rate using RECIST criteria

results.effect_size: Response rate: 55% (95% CI: 23.4-83.0) in bevacizumab ineligible patients, 27% (95% CI: 7.8-55.1) in bevacizumab eligible patients
subgroup_findings: Bevacizumab ineligible patients had significantly higher response rate than bevacizumab eligible patients (55% vs 27%, p=0.01)
results.dose_information: Hydroxychloroquine 200 mg orally BID, Paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 IV over 3 hours, Carboplatin AUC=6 IV, Bevacizumab 15 mg/kg IV (cohort 1 only), cycles every 3 weeks for 4-6 cycles
